title.en: LeetCode · Reason Your Way to the Solution

desc.zh: 从手算、猜测与反例出发，逐步推导算法，再用 Python 实现。首篇 2916：从子数组到区间更新、平方和与懒标记。
desc.en: Derive algorithms through small examples, predictions and counterexamples, then implement them in Python. First lesson: 2916, from subarrays to interval updates and lazy propagation.
